overall: No violation found: the President reached only two other councilors, three total, below the five-member quorum; the AG reminded the Council about out-of-meeting polling and late complaint response without ordering any remedy.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council deliberated via serial communication outside a posted meeting to agree on deferring Councilors' salary raises.
allegations.key_passage: Where a total of three Councilors does not constitute a quorum of the Council, we find that the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by improperly deliberating outside of a posted meeting.

allegations.summary: Council President argued his discussions with colleagues about salary raises were personal matters outside the Council's jurisdiction, so not deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Without divulging specific details or making a formal determination on the matter, we note that we do not agree with President Cain’s characterization of the matters discussed as purely personal and outside of the Council’s jurisdiction.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
